long_description:
**AUSTIN, OUR FAVORITE TIME OF YEAR IS HERE 🪔✨**

A night where the lights shine brighter, the colors feel richer, and the music brings us all a little closer.

This November, NAZAARA Diwali returns to Austin for a celebration of everything we love about this season. Dressed in our finest Desi fits, surrounded by our people, and dancing beneath under the moon full of light ✨

From the Bollywood songs we grew up on to the club bangers and throwbacks that keep us dancing all night long, NAWAB & VEER take us through the soundtrack of Diwali.

**Dress Code: Traditional South Asian Attire**

🪔 NAZAARA DIWALI 

💥 Saturday, November 7 

🪔 The Arrowhead 

💥 Sounds by NAWAB & VEER 

🪔 Bollywood • Club Bangers • Throwbacks
